title: Inside the tools (tools/*)
caption: Workspace packages: amadeus-stub, e2e, reference-data. Plain Node folders without package.json: ci, perf, plan-lint, dev.

nodes.label: server.ts
nodes.detail: Node `http`, 127.0.0.1 only; request log of the last 1000 requests, bodies never recorded.

nodes.label: oauth.ts
nodes.detail: `POST /v1/security/oauth2/token`; tokens live 1799 s in memory.

nodes.label: routes.ts + handlers/*
nodes.detail: 12 operations; Flight Offers Search answers the fixture cut to `max`.

nodes.label: scenarios.ts
nodes.detail: 10 scenarios, magic destination `ZZZ`, declined card `4000000000000002`.

nodes.label: orders.ts
nodes.detail: In-memory flight orders per server.

nodes.label: validate.ts
nodes.detail: Ajv against `docs/amadeus-api/`; unknown body fields refused where asked.

nodes.label: record.ts / scrub.ts
nodes.detail: Manual recording from the Amadeus test host, scrubbed and scanned; never in CI.

nodes.label: fixtures/
nodes.detail: JSON fixtures per API and scenario.

nodes.label: playwright.config.ts
nodes.detail: Projects portal, platform-admin, storefront, ota-admin, portal-stripe, storefront-stripe.

nodes.label: support/stack.ts
nodes.detail: Global setup: fresh `velexis_e2e_<runId>`, migrate, seed reference, start built apps, seed demo OTA.

nodes.label: support/fixtures, seed, ota, tenants, mailpit, totp
nodes.detail: Signed-in fixtures through the platform API; arrangements no screen creates.

nodes.label: storefront-guards.ts, card-leak-guards.ts
nodes.detail: Third-party requests, cookies, a11y; no card value outside the completion request.

nodes.label: specs/**/*.e2e.ts (44 files)
nodes.detail: Portal, platform admin, storefront, OTA admin journeys.

nodes.label: scripts/fetch.mjs, validate.mjs
nodes.detail: Manual download from OpenTravelData + CLDR; `--check` offline.

nodes.label: data/*.csv + overrides.csv + SOURCES.md
nodes.detail: 7 tables, about 23 900 rows; overrides empty by default.

nodes.label: src/load.ts, cli/load.ts
nodes.detail: One transaction: release unique codes, upsert, deactivate; never delete.

nodes.label: tools/ci/*.mjs
nodes.detail: check-package-json, check-no-hardcoded-hosts, check-pci-refs/fix-pci-refs, workflow tests.

nodes.label: tools/plan-lint/plan-lint.mjs
nodes.detail: Validates the three task plans; progress and `--remaining`.

nodes.label: tools/perf/*
nodes.detail: platform-smoke.mjs, gc-observer.cjs, unit-node-options.mjs.

nodes.label: tools/dev/dev-keys.mjs, stripe-listen.sh
nodes.detail: Local key files in `.local/keys/`; Stripe CLI forwarding.

nodes.label: Amadeus test host
nodes.detail: Only `record` calls it, by hand.
